package.description: Cross-platform application to open website or media in a floating window

en-US.description: Cross-platform application to open website or media in a floating window
en-US.longDescription:
Pennywise opens any website or media in a small floating window that remains on top of all other applications.
Pennywise windows stays up all the time.
No need to keep struggling with Alt + Tab, use Pennywise for easy multitasking.
en-US.name: Pennywise
